args.message: Hi Omar - Lumen Industrial Gas invoice LI-54086 (AP doc 5100005592, 27,430.80 USD, due 2026-03-31) is already included in today's automatic payment run F110-0331-A, which executes today at 18:00. Based on recent runs, the bank file goes out around 18:14 and the bank confirms same-day value date. So it will be paid today. I have NOT released a separate manual wire, because that would pay the invoice twice. You can tell Lumen that payment goes out today with value date 2026-03-31. If anything goes wrong with tonight's run, let me know and we'll look at it again.
